title: Rethinking the Information Bottleneck: Structured Decomposition under Label-Induced Partitions
abstract: arXiv:2610.01175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standard information bottleneck (IB) regularization constrains representations via a single scalar I(Z;X), implicitlytreating all information as homogeneous. However, a single global compression control couples label-relevant structurewith residual within-condition variation, rather than regulating their allocation independently, allowing nuisanceinformation to persist in learned representations. For example, in medical imaging applications, residual variation oftenstems from acquisition conditions, background factors, or subject-specific appearance. This issue becomes particularlypronounced in data-limited settings, where models tend to overfit such variation, hindering generalization. While existingregularization methods can stabilize training, control capacity, or shape representation geometry, they do not explicitlyseparate nuisance-like variation from task-supporting structure. translated_title: 重新思考信息瓶颈：标签诱导分区下的结构化分解
translated_abstract: 标准信息瓶颈（IB）正则化通过单一标量 I(Z;X) 来约束表示，隐式地将所有信息视为同质的。然而，单一的全局压缩控制将标签相关结构与条件内的残余变化耦合在一起，而非独立调节二者的分配，导致干扰信息得以在学习到的表示中持续存在。例如，在医学影像应用中，残余变化通常源于采集条件、背景因素或受试者的特定外观。这一问题在数据受限的环境中尤为突出，因为模型往往会对这类变化过拟合，从而阻碍泛化能力。虽然现有的正则化方法可以稳定训练、控制容量或塑造表示的几何结构，但它们并未显式地将类干扰的变化与任务支持的结构分离开来。为了解决这一局限，我们从一个结构性……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文重新审视信息瓶颈方法，提出在标签诱导分区下对表示中的信息进行结构化分解，从而显式地将任务支持结构与类干扰的残余变化分离并独立调节，避免干扰信息残留，提升数据受限场景下的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper rethinks the information bottleneck by structurally decomposing representation information under label-induced partitions, explicitly separating task-supporting structure from nuisance-like residual variation for independent regulation, thereby preventing nuisance information from persisting and improving generalization in data-limited settings.
